policy: Preserve lexical entry identity and lexical relative-import resolution; canonicalize existing ancestors of missing root/import paths before confinement.
controls: Aliased root with a missing import preserves the missing-file error
Missing descendants of an outside symlink are rejected before reading
Entry-file symlinks retain lexical source order and relative imports
The native ARM64 instruction model returns the lexical sibling value
Existing shared loader, ordered-verifier and Java public-ABI cases remain valid

nativeSuites.skipReason: Actual Darwin ARM64 execution needs Apple silicon

scope: Linux x64 focused verification; the complete local and Mac/Linux release gates remain required. No performance or superiority claim.
